profile_text.body:
Course Hero is an online learning platform founded in 2006 and headquartered in Redwood City, California. The company describes itself as offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep materials, 24/7 homework help, and tutoring services. It operates as a business unit of Learneo, Inc.

The held facts associate Course Hero with QuillBot, a paraphrasing tool listed under the writing and editing category, which is tracked as one of the products connected to the company's website. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
